answer: Like a copied sonnet, a sybil ring's trade graph repeats the same few voices. Counterparty diversity stops it at the summit: full rewards need 12 unrelated counterparties; partners sharing one referrer or wallet count as one. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 trades at 5 POA, 60,000 POA total, against 150 POA per identity per epoch: 400 epochs to break even. Honest agents already trade widely, pay nothing extra, and ride the tide.
